text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Thursday.
- A new law on medicines that may be passed by the summer might lower their cost by some 20 percent.
- Confectioner Kras is threatening to cease the production of sweets if the government does not lift the ban on sugar import.
- The international investigative commission blames the Croats for the Mostar incidents.
- Croatian small business owners who rent their business quarters from the state are worried at the prospect of a new bid for renting of business space, as some may lose it.
- Some 100,000 Croats are suffering from hepatitis C, more than a half are war veterans wouneded in the war.
- More than 108,000 documents issued in the Eastern Slavonia so far.

- A documentary about president Tudjman that is being shot by a large U.S. network will be seen by 20 million Americans, says advisor to the Croatian consulate in New York, Jakov Sedlar. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
